evidence.quote: Microstructures and tensile properties of off-stoichiometric Ni3Al–Ni3V pseudo-binary alloys
The microstructures and tensile properties of the off-stoichiometric Ni3Al–Ni3V pseudo-binary alloys were investigated by an FESEM, a TEM, Vickers hardness test, and high-temperature tensile test.
